ui.about_html:
OnePickAway publishes daily football picks computed by its own statistical model (Poisson distribution with the Dixon-Coles correction). The model looks at current-season results, attacking and defensive strength, home and away performance and form, and then adjusts for publicly reported absences (injuries, suspensions) and team news such as a coaching change.

We do not copy picks or articles from other sites. We only use facts - fixtures, results, lists of unavailable players and news headlines as signals - and every number, pick and comment is produced by our model.

Every pick is checked automatically after the match and the full history is public - including the losing ones.

ui.ai_note: Team news (injuries, suspensions, motivation, rotation) is researched automatically with AI and turned into model adjustments. The probabilities themselves come from our statistical model.
ui.method_html:
• Attack and defence strength from this season's results, separately for home and away games, with recent matches weighted more.
  • Our own form index (0-100) from the last 5 matches: points and goal difference, weighted by the opponent's strength and by how recent the match was; overall and separately at home / away.
  • Fixture load: days of rest and number of matches in the last 14 days.
  • Poisson model with the Dixon-Coles correction for the full score distribution.
  • Elo rating as a second, independent estimate of 1X2 chances.
  • Team news researched with AI: absences (by position and importance of the player), motivation, squad rotation and coaching changes.

ui.value_hint: Value = model probability × best odds. Above 1.05 the odds are higher than the model's fair price.

ui.privacy_html:
This page explains what personal data we process when you create an account.

  • What we collect: your e-mail address (to send login links), the nickname you choose, your comments, and your saved favourites and bet slip.
  • Why: to let you sign in, publish your comments and keep your settings on all your devices. We do not sell your data and do not send marketing e-mails without your separate consent.
  • Where: the data is stored by our hosting provider for accounts (Supabase) on servers in the EU.
  • How long: until you delete your account. Comments may be removed by moderators if they break the rules.
  • Your rights: access, correction, deletion, restriction, data portability and objection, and the right to complain to your data protection authority. Write to us using the contact address on the Advertise page.

Without an account the site stores only your preferences (language, filters, favourites) in your own browser.

ui.community_lead: Predict match winners, earn points for correct calls and climb the tipster ranking. Rate our picks with a thumb up or down.
ui.points_rule: Points: a correct call earns the model's fair odds for that outcome (1 / probability, max 10) - a winning favourite at 70% gives 1.43 pts, a correct draw at 28% gives 3.57 pts. A wrong call earns 0. Predictions close at kick-off; other users' predictions become visible only after kick-off.

intro: The model projects {xh} expected goals for {home} and {xa} for {away}.
By our numbers {home} should score around {xh} goals and {away} around {xa}.
analysis.home_record: {home} at home: {s} goals scored and {c} conceded per game.
analysis.away_record: {away} away: {s} goals scored and {c} conceded per game.
analysis.fav_home: The hosts are favourites with a {p} chance of winning.
analysis.fav_away: The visitors are slight favourites at {p} to win.
analysis.balanced: This looks evenly matched; the draw is rated at {p}.
analysis.goals_high: An open game is expected: {p} chance of 3+ goals.
analysis.goals_low: We expect a tight game - {p} chance of 2 goals or fewer.
analysis.news_absence: Recent reports point to squad problems at {team}; the model lowers its rating accordingly.
analysis.news_return: Reports suggest {team} are getting players back from injury.
analysis.news_coach: {team} have had a recent change on the bench, which adds uncertainty.
analysis.motivation_high: {team} have a lot to play for, which the model counts as extra motivation.
analysis.motivation_low: {team} have little at stake, which can lower intensity.
analysis.rotation: {team} may rotate the squad because of another fixture soon.
analysis.fatigue: {team} played {d} days ago, so fatigue is taken into account.
